intervals.label: no beam (switchyard SY120 not operating)
intervals.locator: Fermilab PAC public report, April 2026 meeting, summary section
intervals.note: The experiment has had no beam since summer 2024. The April 2026 PAC report says SY120, which feeds SpinQuest, will not be operated before the long shutdown (planned 2028-29) because of budget constraints; the experiment had planned to take data in Q4 2026 if the switchyard run were not cancelled and has a four-year plan for after the long shutdown. A temporary stop, not an end of the experiment.

name: SpinQuest
notes: Meets the inclusion bar as an approved, operating experiment with an official page, a published spectrometer description (the SeaQuest spectrometer, arXiv:1706.09990) and a collaboration status talk; no physics result paper was found, so no result records are written.

The SpinQuest official site says the experiment "will make use of the same spectrometer used in SeaQuest" and "In the NM4 hall"; it shares site:fermilab-nm4-hall and the detector hardware with experiment:seaquest (separate detector record).
INSPIRE experiment id not looked up: inspirehep.net is off-limits to coverage streams (STREAM_RULES); external.inspire_experiment left null for the integrator.

Status shutdown per the Fermilab PAC April 2026 public report: about 10^15 protons on target in summer 2024, no beam since; SY120 will not be operated before the long shutdown; four-year data-taking plan for after it. The August 2024 talk ("E1039/SpinQuest: 2018 - now") predates that report.

physics_goals.quote: The SpinQuest experiment is designed to explore a very particular aspect of proton and neutron structure: Are the sea quarks orbiting around the spin axis of the nucleon?
physics_goals.value: Explore whether the sea quarks orbit around the spin axis of the nucleon by measuring Drell-Yan asymmetries with a polarised target

physics_goals.quote: Its successor, the SpinQuest (E1039), will access the $\bar{u}$ and $\bar{d}$ Sivers functions using polarized NH$_3$ and ND$_3$ targets.
physics_goals.value: Access the antiquark (u-bar and d-bar) Sivers functions with polarised NH3 and ND3 targets; a non-zero Sivers asymmetry would indicate non-zero sea-quark orbital angular momentum

summary.plain: SpinQuest fires Fermilab's 120 GeV proton beam at a target of spin-aligned protons or deuterons and detects muon pairs from the Drell-Yan process. It asks whether the sea of quark-antiquark pairs inside the proton orbits around the proton's spin axis. It reuses the SeaQuest spectrometer.
summary.technical: Fermilab E1039: transversely polarised NH3/ND3 target (5 T magnet, dynamic nuclear polarisation) in the 120 GeV Main Injector proton beam, in the NM4 hall with the SeaQuest dimuon spectrometer, measuring the Sivers single-spin asymmetry of Drell-Yan dimuons to probe the sea-quark orbital angular momentum and transversity of the nucleon.

unique_capabilities.quote: This system has the longest (along the beam-line) target cell to date for an evaporation refrigerator
unique_capabilities.value: Polarised proton and neutron (NH3/ND3) targets with the longest target cell of an evaporation-refrigerator system, in a high-intensity 120 GeV proton beam
